pages.reason: Exact item-level cross-check found the rear armrest, front-seat organizer, YouClip tablet holder, roof rack, Sleep variants and Aero Cargo Box references already represented in the 2026-08-06 accessory dataset. The brochure's explicit panoramic-roof incompatibility for the roof rack was missing from the trim-only compatibility row and is now recorded in its notes. The 310-litre box volume, 60 kg roof-rack load and 1.90 x 1.30 m Sleep Pack surface remain brochure facts not represented as structured product attributes.

pages.title: Equipment/options matrix, part 1

pages.title: Dimensions and cargo
content: Body width without mirrors 1813 mm; width with mirrors 2069 mm
Ground clearance 220/219 mm and height 1712/1706 mm with 4x2/4x4 footnote
Cargo 667 dm³ VDA / 702 litres under shelf and 1937 dm³ VDA / 2002 litres with rear bench folded, without double floor and spare wheel
pages.reason: The October 2026 price-list page-7 review records a different body-width value (1812 mm) and additional drivetrain-paired candidates. Preserve the 2025 brochure observation as historical evidence; do not overwrite or map paired dimensions until exact diagram labels and configuration applicability are confirmed. Cargo values require the existing measurement/seat-state context; seat angles and interior measurements must not be mapped to unrelated attributes.

pages.title: Legal and publication notes
pages.reason: Legal applicability caveats govern interpretation; no vehicle master observation.

cross_source_findings.finding: Brochure page 23 gives body width without mirrors as 1813 mm; the October 2026 price-list page-7 inventory records 1812 mm.
cross_source_findings.decision: Preserve both source-bound observations; do not overwrite or collapse the discrepancy.

cross_source_findings.finding: Brochure page 20 cargo figures distinguish repair kit/spare wheel and measurement basis; page 23 gives generic capacity without double floor and spare wheel.
cross_source_findings.decision: Do not infer applicability from numerical similarity; retain the existing cargo context model and explicit deferrals.

cross_source_findings.finding: The brochure uses Hybrid-G 150 4x4 naming and the October 2026 catalogue uses Tribrid 150 4x4 naming.
cross_source_findings.decision: Use explicit source/configuration relationships and dated naming reconciliation; do not duplicate or rename historical source observations by inference.

cross_source_findings.finding: Equipment summaries on pages 15-18 and detailed matrix pages 21-22 describe the 2025 brochure state, while the 2026-10-01 price list is the current MY26 commercial source.
cross_source_findings.decision: Use the October price list for current availability/prices and retain the brochure for historical/contextual evidence.

cross_source_findings.finding: The Bigster brochure page 19 explicitly says the roof rack is incompatible with the panoramic glass roof; the existing accessory compatibility table only carried trim-level compatibility.
cross_source_findings.decision: Add the exact source-backed incompatibility as a row note; retain product capacities and dimensions as unmodeled rather than inventing new attribute schema.

master_reconciliation.reason: Page-by-page text and rendered review is complete, but a complete value-by-value comparison of every candidate against the full 2.4 MB data/master/configuration_attribute_values.csv and accessory master/import records has not been completed through the current GitHub connector. The connector returned empty content for the large master CSV; no source fact has been inferred from that limitation.
